facts.business: Fermenta Biotech Limited manufactures and sells premium APIs, intermediates, green chemistry, and nutritional ingredients, including vitamins, enzymes, and fermentation-based products, to over 400 customers in more than 60 countries.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capacity enhancement of Cholesterol, biotech facility, calcifediol project spray dryer capacity and other upgradation projects
Reactor with Accessories for Saponification Process (overdue project)

key_risks: Recoverability of investments in and loans given to overseas subsidiary (Fermenta Biotech GmbH) which has incurred losses in prior and current periods due to unfavorable market conditions
Significant estimates relating to estimated future cash flows, associated discount rates and growth rates based on management's view of future business prospects for impairment assessment
Changes to assumptions could lead to material adjustments to carrying amounts of investments, loans and receivables from subsidiary
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the standalone financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
